{{Quote|I know what you are. If I turn you in to the Empire, they will pay well. But first&hellip; I'm going to make you suffer!|Drexl Roosh to [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (video game)">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>}}
'''Drexl Roosh''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] leader of the [[Rodian Salvager's Cartel]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]].

==Biography==
Drexl Roosh was the founder and leader of a [[Rodian Salvager's Cartel|group of scavengers]] that operated on [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]]. A vicious [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who was motivated by greed. He once allied to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], before being wanted for at least thirty-eight counts of fraud, selling faulty material and illegal [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] trading. To avoid imprisonment, he retreated to Raxus Prime, where he oversaw a Rodian salvage operation.

He loathed [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]], even though he employed many as part of his Raxus Prime operation. Despite his bluster, he secretly feared [[Kazdan Paratus]], a mad [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who was hiding on the junk world. Drexl preferred to let his troops do his fighting for him. However, if pressed into battle, he often donned heavy armor and wielded a large [[Vibrosword/Legends|vibrosword]].
[[File:Drexl.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Drexl Roosh]]
He and his scavengers fought [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] secret apprentice, [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]], during the latter's mission on the scavenger world. When Roosh demanded payment from Starkiller in exchange for providing Paratus' location, Starkiller [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force-choked]] him into speaking. Drexl vowed revenge, and later he and his men cornered and attacked Starkiller, also revealing that he recognized Starkiller as being wanted by the Empire, and citing his intention of turning him in for a bounty. However, he was defeated in the ensuing duel. Knocked to the ground, he laughed maniacally, hoping to distract the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force user]] long enough to allow one of his cartel's [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|LAAT]] gunships to get a fix on him. However, the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] attacked the gunship and sent it crashing down on top of Drexl, supposedly [[Death/Legends|killing]] him.

On Starkiller's second visit to Raxus Prime, he fought Drexl and his henchmen in a tunnel leading to his hideout. Drexl was furious that Starkiller had defeated Kazdan Paratus, whose [[Droid/Legends|droids]] kept the Empire away; with him gone, the Empire had stripped Raxus of its metals, leaving little to scavenge. Drexl found a [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]] and tried to escape certain death. Starkiller picked up Drexl and his jetpack with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and lifted him far into the air. The Rodian started his jetpack and put it on full throttle to attempt to escape. The young Sith apprentice released his grip and Drexl went speeding to the ground because of the jetpack's force. He hit the ground and the jetpack exploded, finally killing him.

==Behind the scenes==
Drexl appears in the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 2|PlayStation 2]], [[Wikipedia:Wii|Wii]] and [[Wikipedia:PlayStation Portable|PSP]] versions of [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed|''The Force Unleashed'' video game]], as well as in [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|the novel]]. He does not appear in the [[Wikipedia:Personal computer|PC]], [[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] or [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]] versions of the game.

Drexl's battle with Starkiller differs between the novel and the game. In the game, Drexl is killed when Starkiller throws a gunship on top of him. However, in the novel, he is killed in Starkiller's fight with the Rodian in the tunnels leading to his hideout.

In the game, if the player enters DREXLROOSH as a cheat code, they can play as Drexl.

He shares a first name with the [[drexl]] beast of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]].
